api.state: focusArea includes availability/workspace/preview state, requested/effective settings, stroke count, output and error. selectionRefinement.workspaceOpen now distinguishes Focus Area mode.
api.schemas: Strict settings, stroke, output, state and result discovery. Ordinary editing and new-document outputs share native preparation/refinement output and lifecycle guards.
api.limits: Native8,388,608 canvas/source pixels;1MP working analysis. API shared-document4,194,304 canvas pixels/64 layers/128MiB and4MiB request.1024 strokes,4096 points per stroke,16384 total points,250000000 brush pixel visits. Ordinary raster targets; sampling/analysis uses SDR/sRGB proxy.

adobe_api.status: No dedicated Focus Area route in pinned Photoshop v2 contract. Focus actionJSON descriptors remain unqualified. Existing Adobe routes are unchanged; native API support does not establish Adobe conformance.

menus.shortcut: Captured factory menu order retained; no primary shortcut invented. Local Undo/Redo routing shared with Select and Mask.

limitations: Exact Adobe focus detection, Auto estimates, numeric/default ranges and pixels remain unqualified; native range0–10 and noise0–1 are explicit current controls, not a verified factory-default claim.
Real-photo noise/depth-of-field quality and large-image performance require broader independent qualification. Source-derived heuristics are not Adobe proprietary inference.
Native outputs currently require an ordinary raster layer. Smart Object/live type/group/component targets require appropriate conversion; broader contexts remain open.
Nonselection Actions/Adobe descriptors and complete S02 Color Range/Magnetic Lasso requirements remain open.
Offscreen synthetic preview is not live UI qualification. Latest authoritative desktop state remains locked; no re-probe. Physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 and full Photoshop equivalence remain open.
actions: Focus selection output records explicit resulting coverage in Actions4. Mask/new-layer outputs create visible unsupported recording entries. No adaptive re-detection or complete Focus Actions/Batch claim.
next: Major Mask All Objects with local per-instance detection, editable masked groups, original image retention, factory menu/context entry, native history and API. Then broader Object Finder/People workflows; fine numerical/cosmetic work remains deferred.
